EVIDENCE:
1. Pod `catalog-6b8cf764b7-8dff9`, container `catalog`: Image `docker.io/library/nginx:1.99`, State Waiting, Reason `ImagePullBackOff`, Restart Count 0 (my call: describe pod catalog-6b8cf764b7-8dff9, namespace shop; diag-k8s made the same read).
2. Pod events: `Failed to pull image "docker.io/library/nginx:1.99": ... docker.io/library/nginx:1.99: not found` (code NotFound), then `Error: ErrImagePull`, then `Error: ImagePullBackOff` with Back-off events (my call: describe pod catalog-6b8cf764b7-8dff9, namespace shop).
3. Namespace events: the same NotFound pull error and ErrImagePull/ImagePullBackOff also appear on the earlier pod `catalog-6b8cf764b7-td86w` (count 4 ErrImagePull, 8 ImagePullBackOff), so this is not a one-off pod problem (diag-k8s call: events, warnings_only true, namespace shop).
4. Deployment `catalog`, revision 1 (`deployment.kubernetes.io/revision: "1"`, no change-cause), template image `docker.io/library/nginx:1.99`, `imagePullPolicy: IfNotPresent`, no imagePullSecrets; status `Available=False`, reason `MinimumReplicasUnavailable`, `unavailableReplicas: 1` (diag-k8s call: get deployment catalog, namespace shop, raw true).
5. Logs: `container "catalog" in pod "catalog-6b8cf764b7-8dff9" is waiting to start: image can't be pulled`, so there is no container output to read (diag-k8s call: logs pod catalog-6b8cf764b7-8dff9, namespace shop).

FIX (not applied): change the image of Deployment `shop/catalog` from `docker.io/library/nginx:1.99` to an existing tag (for example `docker.io/library/nginx:1.27`, after confirming the tag exists in the registry) so the new ReplicaSet can pull and start.
